utterances.speaker: Speaker 1
utterances.text: The community garden open day is on Saturday, 17 October 2026. We need to sort out the volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Speaker 2
utterances.text: Last year's open day was busy, but the photos looked great.

utterances.speaker: Speaker 1
utterances.text: I will print twenty sign-in sheets by Thursday, 15 October 2026.

utterances.speaker: Speaker 2
utterances.text: Could you email the volunteer coordinator a copy as well?

utterances.speaker: Speaker 1
utterances.text: Yes, I will email the sheets on Thursday afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Speaker 2
utterances.text: I was going to order new name badges tomorrow, 14 October 2026.

utterances.speaker: Speaker 1
utterances.text: Please don't order badges. I found a full box in the cupboard.

utterances.speaker: Speaker 2
utterances.text: I will collect the folding tables from the library on Friday, 16 October 2026, at 3 pm.

utterances.speaker: Speaker 1
utterances.text: The library just changed pickup to Saturday, 17 October 2026, at 9:30 am.

utterances.speaker: Speaker 2
utterances.text: All right, I will collect the tables at the new time instead.

utterances.speaker: Speaker 1
utterances.text: Could you bring two watering cans too?

utterances.speaker: Speaker 2
utterances.text: Maybe. I need to check whether they fit in my bag.

utterances.speaker: Speaker 1
utterances.text: Let's decide about the watering cans after you check.

utterances.speaker: Speaker 2
utterances.text: I will call the site manager on Wednesday, 14 October 2026, to confirm the gate code.

utterances.speaker: Speaker 1
utterances.text: I'll send directions to the volunteers before the open day, but I don't know the exact day yet.

utterances.speaker: Speaker 2
utterances.text: We could paint the fence one day, but let's leave that for another meeting.

utterances.speaker: Speaker 1
utterances.text: Thanks. The meeting notes from last month are already in the shared folder.
